label: Context macro series for mandate v6 tests; outside data/ so the frozen pipeline's data hash is unchanged.
source: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), fredgraph.csv downloads
retrieval: Downloaded by the owner and uploaded to the session on 2026-10-31 (this environment's network policy blocks fred.stlouisfed.org); not a programmatic retrieval

series.UNRATE: Civilian unemployment rate, monthly, seasonally adjusted, percent (revised vintage as downloaded); 2025-10 blank as published
series.BAA10Y: Moody's Baa corporate yield minus 10-year Treasury, daily, percentage points

use: UNRATE: Sahm-rule test (documented backup, not in the v6 rule). BAA10Y: tested and rejected as too noisy. Values after 2026-09-30 are never used.
